title: Add Copilot feature trial interface
summary: Added a public Copilot feature trial interface to System Application, enabling applications to initiate trials, query remaining quota, and consume trial usage with corresponding implementation codeunits and tests.
key_points: Adds a public Copilot Feature Trial codeunit, backed by an implementation codeunit, to start trials, query remaining quota and consume trial usage
Moves the Copilot quota objects into the Consumption and Billing folder
Adds the required DotNet aliases and an AI module dependency
Adds System Application tests for trial state and quota behavior
quote: Add a public Copilot feature trial interface so applications can start trials, query remaining quota, and consume trial usage.
